summary: Take the bounding box of all nonzero input cells. Let its top-left be (r0,c0), its dimensions be bh by bw, its source color be the top-left cell, its complement be 9 minus that color, and its period be bh+bw. At anchors (r0+k*period,c0+sign*k*period), for integer k and both diagonal signs, first stamp every intersecting bw-by-bh quarter-turned rectangle at (anchor_row+bh, anchor_col+(bw if sign is positive else -bh)) in the complementary color, clipping outside the canvas. Then stamp every distinct intersecting bh-by-bw diagonal rectangle in the source color, so source stamps win overlaps.
